# Northstar support handbook

This handbook contains fictional policies for a private product rehearsal.

## Resetting a demo workspace

An operator may reset the fictional demo workspace from Settings > Demo data. The reset removes only synthetic rehearsal records. A reset must be approved by the rehearsal owner.

## Supported hours

Synthetic support coverage is 09:00–17:00 on weekdays in the fictional workspace timezone.

## Escalation

Accessibility issues are assigned to the rehearsal accessibility owner. The handbook intentionally does not specify refund, billing, legal, or production incident policies.
